disposition: Bounded synthetic replay and arithmetic checks passed. No learned model promotion, physical latency qualification or clinical qualification.

execution.browser: local Chrome headless via Playwright; exact user agent retained per run
execution.source_fixture_buffer_note: The fixture loops a two-second mono float32 AudioBuffer. At 48 kHz this is 96,000 samples, or 384,000 PCM payload bytes, independent of the scheduled run duration. Browser object/allocation overhead was not measured.

timing_benchmark_flags.scope: Sequential same-machine descriptive measurements. Ordinary desktop background load and power/thermal conditions were uncontrolled; not an exclusive-hardware or physical-input latency benchmark.

metadata_correction.original_value: Full scheduled synthetic audio buffer scales with replay duration; separate from bounded streaming queues
metadata_correction.corrected_value: The fixture loops a two-second mono float32 AudioBuffer. At 48 kHz this is 96,000 samples, or 384,000 PCM payload bytes, independent of the scheduled run duration. Browser object/allocation overhead was not measured.
metadata_correction.effect: Metadata correction only. No source, timing, prediction, test artifact or original manifest was changed.

model_scope: Original trained MLP, not augmented MLP. Research-only sibling prediction; original DSP frame and observation contract unchanged. MLP quality gates failed.

measurement_definitions.frameServiceMs: Elapsed feature and baseline preparation, excluding ORT inference in the MLP path.
measurement_definitions.completeBlockServiceMs: Elapsed admitted handleBlock execution including optional ORT completion, PCM recycle and data-envelope post; excludes pre-handler queue waiting and completion-envelope post.
measurement_definitions.sampleAvailabilityToMainResultMs: Main completion-envelope arrival minus required-input boundary mapped using one fixed audio/performance anchor; not measured physical microphone latency.
measurement_definitions.blockEndToWorkerReceiptMs: Worker receive callback time minus fixed-anchor mapped block end; research receipt is before async-pump admission.
measurement_definitions.modelInferenceServiceMs: Elapsed ONNX model prediction per frame, distinct from complete preparation/transport.
measurement_definitions.modelTarget: Support end minus 20 ms; earliest sample availability is 20 ms after the research target.
measurement_definitions.quantiles: Nearest rank, no interpolation; each original summary includes n and null for unavailable metrics.
measurement_definitions.validTiming: Internal consistency only; not calibrated audio-clock accuracy. Unknown audio clock precision remains null.

method.receipt_weighting: One value per delivered frame, as in the browser summary; a block receipt can contribute twice.
method.eligibility: Arrival and receipt include non-null values only; raw worker-to-main differences are retained separately without clamping.
method.raw_difference_scope: workerReadyToMainArrivalRawMs is after legacy DSP frame preparation; workerReceiptToMainArrivalRawMs includes admitted processing and downstream delivery. Neither subtracts the audio anchor.

end_clock_comparison.limitation: Different start/stop boundaries, phase and clock rate can contribute. This difference is not a fitted correction or proof of drift.

soak_trend.interpretation: Reported arrival and pre-worker-receipt intervals increase while block service and receipt-to-main durations remain much smaller. The single static audio/performance mapping cannot identify clock-rate/phase error versus upstream scheduling or transport delay. No extrapolation or stable end-to-end latency claim.

limits: No physical microphone or display latency measurement.
No heap-growth measurement or qualification beyond the observed 30-minute run.
The growing mapped arrival time remains unresolved; no clock-drift correction or queue-growth conclusion is asserted.
Only a repeated synthetic 200 Hz harmonic signal was used; no new speech or sealed-test data.
No F0 correctness calibration, seed confirmation, live microphone demonstration or voice duration/coverage aggregate qualification.
The original and augmented learned models remain unqualified by the separate scientific results.
Stop acknowledgements establish terminal snapshots, not proof that every in-flight result reached analysis.
